title: R2A-Sales: A Policy-Atom-Matched Benchmark for Rule-to-Action Gaps in Goal-Directed Sales Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based sales agents are often evaluated on static policy questions or task success, but deployment asks a sharper question: when a model can state a rule, will it choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure? We introduce R2A-Sales (Rule-to-Action), a policy-atom-matched benchmark for this question. Each item pairs a static probe with a multi-turn sales scenario sharing the same versioned policy atom, facts, evidence, behavioral constraints, and tool contract, so differences cannot be attributed to policy-content mismatch. In the interactive arm, a code-owned ledger verifies committed tool effects and terminal states; unsupported action claims receive no credit. We report static compliance $K$, grounded action compliance $A=\Pr(\text{safe terminal}\land\text{no hard violation}\land\text{non-echo})$, and the matched gap $G=K-A$. translated_title: R2A-Sales：面向目标导向销售智能体“从规则到行动”差距的策略原子匹配基准
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的销售智能体通常在静态政策问答或任务完成度上被评估，但实际部署提出了一个更尖锐的问题：当模型能够陈述某条规则时，它在商业压力下是否会选择合规的、有工具支撑的行动？我们提出了 R2A-Sales（Rule-to-Action，规则到行动），一个针对该问题的策略原子匹配基准。每个条目将一个静态探针与一个多轮销售场景配对，二者共享同一版本化的策略原子、事实、证据、行为约束和工具契约，因此差异无法归因于政策内容不匹配。在交互部分，由代码控制的账本验证已提交的工具效果和终止状态；缺乏支撑的行动声明不予计分。我们报告静态合规率 K、落地行动合规率 A=Pr(安全终止 ∧ 无硬性违规 ∧ 非复读)，以及匹配差距 G=K−A。该冻结发布版本涵盖三个受控的中文销售领域和 24 个策略原子。
tldr: 提出 R2A-Sales 基准，通过将静态政策问答与共享同一版本化策略原子的多轮销售交互场景配对，量化大模型销售智能体在“能陈述规则”与“能在商业压力下执行合规、有工具支撑的行动”之间的规则到行动差距。
en_tdlr: R2A-Sales is a policy-atom-matched benchmark that pairs static rule-statement probes with multi-turn sales scenarios sharing identical versioned policy atoms, quantifying the gap between LLM agents' ability to state rules and their ability to choose compliant, tool-grounded actions under commercial pressure.
